description: Audience clinician. note and record_copy source the same two nodes (the problem loop, then
note_body) and compose to the same bytes: the input's items named by the input's label plus
position ('Problem list 1', not the loop's label 'Problems'), then the scalar after a blank
line. Both checks pass (each extracted list holds every coded term of the draft's), so both are
composed. patient_copy: its if does not hold, so it is skipped with the reason
cover_letter: cover_note's prompt reads deliverable.note.content (the composed note, before its
check settles) and its patient-copy line is gated off by input.audience. patient_line still runs:
the cover prompt's read of deliverable.patient_copy keeps it in the run.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin. (Fictional.)
problems: Type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol (fictional)

outputs.note_body: Closing paragraph: review in three months.
outputs.patient_line: Your sugar levels are high; we will review your tablets.
outputs.cover_note: Please find the clinic note enclosed.
